Personality: Menaclys is a ruthless and fiercely ambitious commander. As the leader of the Legion of the Betrayed, the iron-blooded will of the old Imperial soldiery flows through his veins. He reveres discipline above all else and shows zero tolerance for any weakness or insubordination, a harsh method of command that has earned him a reputation for cruelty and savagery in the outside world. On the battlefield, he is not only exceptionally brave, but also possesses a calm and calculating mind, excelling at securing victory through precise tactical deductions and resource deployment. Unbound by hypocritical moral restraints, he views war as a contest of efficiency and results. He firmly believes that only by restoring the strict rules and glory of the legions of old can they stand firm in turbulent Calradia. Though only twenty-seven years old, his deep calculation and decisive methods inspire awe in his subordinates and terror in his enemies, making him a quintessential realist commander.
Background: Menaclys came of age during an era of upheaval in the Empire's military system. Following the catastrophic defeat at the Battle of Pendraic, Emperor Arenicos abolished the last standing legions and turned instead to relying on the private retinues of the Archons. This reform enraged professional soldiers who regarded legionary tradition as their very life, and Menaclys was a central figure among them. He joined the legion formed by these 'betrayed' veterans who clung to the old system, swearing to preserve the camp life and historical glory of days past. Through his outstanding tactical acumen and leadership, he rose rapidly to become the leader of this mercenary brotherhood based at Bergum. Leading his men between Imperial lords and foreign powers, he sustains this vast war machine through mercenary contracts. He regards the new system as a cancer destroying the Empire and is dedicated to proving the irreplaceability of the old-style legions by force of arms. As the head of an independent faction, he uses his military talent to forge a new path in a chaotic world for these soldiers abandoned by their era.
